title: Fullstack Developer (Node.js + React + AWS)
description:
About You

You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys owning complex systems end-to-end. You are passionate about building scalable, production-grade applications in the cloud and want to contribute to architectural decisions while mentoring others and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first environment.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
  • 7+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Proven experience building full-stack applications using React and TypeScript . Experience with modern React state management patterns.
  • Solid experience designing and operating REST and/or GraphQL APIs .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and S3.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures in production environments.
  • Strong experience with DynamoDB in production environments, including single-table design, partition/sort key strategies, TTL, and cost-efficient scaling.
  • Experience supporting hybrid architectures , including coexistence with legacy SQL-based systems.
  • Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or other IaC tools (CloudFormation, Terraform)
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitHub Actions).
  • Solid understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability using CloudWatch or similar tools.
  • Strong frontend skills with state management patterns such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand.
  • Advanced English proficiency and ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Develop and operate high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Implement and evolve event-driven architectures using AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, and API Gateway.
  • Model and optimize data access patterns in DynamoDB, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support system evolution by enabling hybrid architectures during migrations from legacy platforms to serverless solutions.
  • Provision and manage infrastructure using AWS CDK and cloud-native best practices.
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines covering linting, testing, building, deployments, and environment management.
  • Ensure production readiness through proper logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability.
  • Build and maintain frontend applications using React and TypeScript, applying clean component architecture and performance optimizations.
  • Collaborate closely with product, backend, and frontend teams to deliver cohesive full-stack solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless : Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB.
  • Experience designing and operating REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus).
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures in production environments.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with 30 years of experience, is seeking a Salesforce OEM Application Developer to support a US-based customer. This position collaborates with development teams in the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, focusing on designing, developing, and maintaining a managed Salesforce OEM application.


This role is ideal for someone with deep Salesforce development expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in English.


About the Role:


As a Salesforce OEM Application Developer, you will work closely with product managers, clients, and internal teams to gather and refine technical requirements, translate business needs into robust application features, and maintain a secure, scalable Salesforce OEM solution. You will develop advanced functionality combining code and configuration, manage integrations and data migrations, troubleshoot application-level issues, and support packaging, versioning, and upgrades of the managed application.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain a managed Salesforce OEM application using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.
  • Build advanced Salesforce functionality, including complex Flows, triggers, asynchronous processing, and Community/Experience Cloud implementations .
  • Architect scalable and secure solutions aligned with Salesforce OEM/ISV best practices , including multi-tenant considerations and upgrade-safe design.
  • Develop and maintain custom data models, integrations, and automation , ensuring performance, governor-limit compliance, and maintainability.
  • Manage data migration and transformation processes using Apex, ETL tools, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application-level issues including Apex logic, automation conflicts, and deployment errors.
  • Build test classes with strong code coverage and participate in CI/CD and release management activities.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation , including architecture workbooks, developer/admin guides, testing strategies, and deployment protocols.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators and customer technical teams to ensure correct configuration and extension of the OEM application.


Required Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience , including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Proven experience blending programmatic development and declarative configuration for scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced Flows, triggers, and automation based on business rules.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, security, permissions, sharing models, and performance optimization .
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders to design sophisticated user experiences across screens, records, and automation processes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern release practices .
  • Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, Administrator or Advanced Administrator (Platform App Builder preferred).
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with C# and the .NET ecosystem for backend services or integrations.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows for code generation, testing, or documentation.
  • Prior experience building or supporting OEM/ISV applications , including managed packages, AppExchange distribution, or Salesforce Security Review preparation.
  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

title: Gerente de Technical Advisor
description:
Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS)


Descrição da vaga


  • Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar a estratégia da área (planejamento, orçamento, cronograma e indicadores);
  • Participar da construção da estratégia de negócios dos clientes e da Diretoria;
  • Garantir o engajamento com a estratégia da Diretoria/Empresa, desdobrando todas as iniciativas com o time;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Promover sinergia entre as áreas de Soluções e demais Diretorias/Áreas de empresa;
  • Orientar as áreas de negócios em relação as melhores práticas;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria nos processos de vendas, desenvolvendo ações alinhadas com as necessidades dos processos das áreas de negócio;
  • Gestão do atendimento dos clientes garantindo o sucesso nos negócios utilizando nossos produtos e serviços
  • Atuar na elaboração e execução de um plano para a intensificação do uso das tecnologias adquiridas para alavancar seus processos de negócio;
  • Garantir que as demandas necessárias a estratégia de negócio do cliente, tenham os recursos e ações direcionadas conforme sua expectativa;
  • Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os Canais de Venda no desenvolvimento das contas e com a área de Suporte e Customer Success garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Gestão de faturamento e custos;
  • Gestão da alocação dos profissionais conforme meta e políticas estabelecidas.
  • Elaborar, conferir e validar Relatórios Gerenciais para apoiar na tomada de decisões da empresa;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos projetos, melhoria dos processos e das atividades compartilhadas ou interdependentes, identificando e aplicando boas práticas de mercado e realizando reuniões interdepartamentais;
  • Gerenciar atividades da área, estabelecendo cronogramas, indicadores de desempenho e orientando sobre a forma a se fazer cumprir as metas de produtividade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e negociados, visando assegurar o cumprimento de todas as obrigações da empresa;
  • Negociar prazos para o fornecimento de informações pelas gerências, avaliar a qualidade destas e acompanhar o lançamento destes dados, visando assegurar a qualidade do relatório e sua entrega nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Realizar a Gestão de Pessoas, acompanhar, avaliar e desenvolver o time;
  • Ser referência no exercício da nossa cultura, estar envolvido com nosso negócio, se interessar pelo desenvolvimento da sua área e da empresa como um todo
  • Realizar a gestão e controle orçamentário da área;
  • Realizar a gestão de Processos, adesão as Políticas de Qualidade e gestão de riscos e mudanças.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em GIS (Geographic Information System), IT (Technology Information) em Estratégia de Empresas;
  • Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Gestão de Pessoas e Performance de Times;
  • Experiência com o ArcGIS;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

description:
Código da vaga:57766


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Responsabilidades:


Bons conhecimentos em peças de CRM, mídia e social - campanhas digitais.

Pacote Office;

Excelente conhecimento da língua portuguesa;

Criação de textos para banners, e-mails e sites;

Roteiros simples e mini vídeos;

Bom senso estético;


  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Our US client, is seeking a leader for their Product Development team. This team builds business-critical applications that support customers across the global food and beverage supply chain. They need a hands-on Software Engineering Manager for their Brazil Delivery Center to lead and grow a .NET development team. You will be responsible for recruiting, mentoring, and managing top talent, ensuring high performance and continuous professional growth.


Job Duties:

People & Delivery Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a remote team of full-stack software engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching and feedback, and support career development for team members.
  • Partner with Product Management, QA, DevOps, and other global engineering teams to plan and deliver cloud features aligned with customer migration needs.
  • Own delivery outcomes for the SaaS platform, ensuring predictable, high-quality releases and effective post–go-live support.
  • Participate in hiring and onboarding of new engineers as the team continues to scale.
  • Hands-On Technical Leadership
  • Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of a SaaS application using the same tools and practices as the engineering team.
  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure.
  • Support front-end development using HTML and TypeScript.
  • Review code, guide architectural decisions, and ensure adherence to coding standards, security best practices, and performance requirements.
  • Leverage AI-powered developer tools and assistants to improve code quality, reduce repetitive work, and accelerate delivery.


Engineering Excellence

  • Promote best practices in software architecture, testing, CI/CD, and DevOps.
  • Ensure appropriate monitoring, logging, and operational readiness using tools such as Application Insights and Kusto.
  • Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives across development processes and team workflows.


Qualifications:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 3+ years of experience leading or managing software engineers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
  • .NET / C# for RESTful API development
  • TypeScript / JavaScript and modern web application development
  • SQL databases (Azure SQL or similar)
  • Experience building and operating cloud-based applications on Microsoft Azure.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and secure application development.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to lead distributed, cross-functional teams.


Preferred

  • YAML-based infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience using AI APIs or AI-assisted development tools (Cursor or similar).


This role is CRT and starts at R$20,000/Month

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Python Sênior - Dialogflow
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Python com foco em Dialogflow para integrar nosso time de tecnologia, atuando diretamente na construção e evolução de soluções de IA conversacional.


Buscamos alguém com experiência sólida em Python e vivência na criação de jornadas conversacionais no Dialogflow, integrando fluxos, APIs e serviços backend para entregar experiências conversacionais eficientes, escaláveis e bem estruturadas.


Se você gosta de trabalhar com bots, NLP, integrações e arquiteturas conversacionais, essa vaga é pra você.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Desenvolver e manter serviços backend em Python com foco em soluções conversacionais;
  • Criar, testar e evoluir jornadas conversacionais no Dialogflow;
  • Integrar fluxos do Dialogflow com APIs, serviços backend e modelos de linguagem, quando necessário;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros desenvolvedores e times de produto para transformar necessidades em soluções funcionais;
  • Participar da evolução da arquitetura das jornadas, garantindo escalabilidade, qualidade e performance.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento em Python;
  • Vivência prática com Dialogflow na construção de bots e jornadas conversacionais;
  • Familiaridade com APIs REST e estruturas assíncronas (FastAPI, Flask, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento em LLMs, embeddings e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation);
  • Experiência com PostgreSQL, Redis ou bancos vetoriais como FAISS, Weaviate, pgvector.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Experiência prática com LangChain e/ou LangGraph.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

  • Experiencia com Software de Monitoramento Zabbix / Datadog;
  • Experiencia com Redes e Protocolos de Segurança;
  • Experiencia em ambientes de Cloud Privada;

  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;

description:

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Senior Data Engineer


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Maintain and evolve Fraud Deflect’s data stack: reliable pipelines, strong data models, and stable production operations on Linux. Focus is improving what exists, not rewriting everything.


Responsibilities

  • Own data architecture and data modeling for core datasets.
  • Maintain and improve existing pipelines (stability, backfills, performance, data quality).
  • Build/operate Airflow workflows (SLAs, retries, alerting, idempotency).
  • Write and optimize SQL in MySQL (schemas, migrations, indexing, query tuning).
  • Develop pipeline/tooling code in Python.
  • Operate and debug on Linux (services/jobs, logs, incidents, automation).
  • Work within the current stack (Airflow, AWS, MySQL; ClickHouse is a plus).
  • Add basic observability; dashboards/visuals are a plus.
  • Communicate clearly; apply strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.


Required

  • Strong MySQL/SQL (mandatory).
  • Airflow in production.
  • AWS experience.
  • Python proficiency.
  • Comfortable maintaining systems on Linux.
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills.


Nice to have

  • Observability/visualization (metrics, dashboards, alerting).
  • Prior Clickhouse experience.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: Consultor de Governança
description:
Buscamos um profissional para liderar a estruturação e a manutenção do nosso ecossistema de dados. O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog , estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).
  • Políticas de Governança: Desenvolver e implementar políticas de governança de dados e IA, garantindo que o ciclo de vida dos dados esteja em conformidade com normas (como LGPD) e boas práticas de mercado.
  • Documentação Técnica: Atuar ativamente na criação de catálogos de dados, dicionários, diagramas de linhagem e manuais de processos. A documentação será um pilar central da entrega.
  • Governança de IA: Estabelecer diretrizes para o uso ético e seguro de modelos de IA, monitorando a qualidade dos dados de entrada (inputs) e a rastreabilidade dos modelos.
  • Segurança e Acessos: Definir e gerenciar perfis de acesso, garantindo que a democratização dos dados ocorra de forma segura.
  • Colaboração: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e Stakeholders de negócio para garantir a integridade da informação.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog .
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).
  • Vivência com frameworks de Governança de Dados (DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Databricks (Certified Data Engineer ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração para ambientes de governança centralizada.


Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Analítico: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de informação de forma lógica.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor com a padronização e qualidade da documentação.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de explicar políticas complexas de forma simples para diferentes áreas.

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:

You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. title: Back End Developer
description:
Senior PHP Backend Engineer (Laravel / Symfony)


US Hours | High-Impact Platform | Excellent Compensation


We’re partnering with a long-standing US client to hire a Senior PHP Backend Engineer to help build and scale a mission-critical enterprise platform used by real users every day.


This is not a CMS or agency role.


This is a backend ownership role focused on payments, workflows, reporting, and scalable services.

If you’ve built and supported production PHP systems with real databases and real transactions, this role is worth your time.

title: Full Stack Engineer PHP/Javascript
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer


Role Type: Full-Time Regular Employment

Setup: Fully Remote

Duration: Open-ended, Long term

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: US Eastern Time (EST)

Rate: USD 3,500-4,000 per month


Position Overview:


The Senior Full Stack Engineer will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining our client’s core business applications. We are looking for a true systems analyst who thrives on solving complex business challenges and translating them into robust, scalable, and high-performing technical solutions. This individual must be highly comfortable working with pure code without relying on frameworks , especially in areas where the company prefers clean, raw implementations. The ideal candidate should have strong foundational skills in vanilla JavaScript , pure PHP , and writing code from scratch without the support of abstractions or libraries.


You will work across both the front-end and back-end of modern web applications using PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL, and React , collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver efficient and maintainable systems. Strong English communication skills are essential for interacting with internal stakeholders, product owners, and developers across global teams.


What You Will Do:


The individual in this position will be expected, on a regular basis, to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end functionality for enterprise-level business applications using PHP in pure form , avoiding unnecessary frameworks when required.
  • Build and enhance interactive, responsive front-end interfaces using vanilla JavaScript , along with React when applicable.
  • Develop and optimize databases using MySQL and PostgreSQL , including schema design, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
  • Write clean, well-structured, and well-tested code without depending heavily on frameworks, ensuring clarity and maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and long-term stability.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to decisions involving raw code structure, system design, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to ensure the product is performant, reliable, and aligned with business goals.
  • Stay updated with evolving best practices in no-framework development , JavaScript, PHP, SQL, and full stack engineering.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers, especially in understanding code fundamentals and building solutions without relying on frameworks.
  • Prepare and maintain clear and detailed technical documentation.


What You Will Bring:


  • Proven ability to write clean, well-documented, and well-tested pure code in both PHP and JavaScript (examples may be requested).
  • Strong knowledge of vanilla JavaScript , DOM manipulation, event handling, and building functionality without libraries.
  • Expertise in MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL , with hands-on experience designing and maintaining relational databases.
  • Proficiency with React or modern front-end frameworks, while still having the ability to work without them when needed.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming (OOP) and design patterns.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in agile, team-based environments.
  • Knowledge of the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry is a plus.
  • A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and a passion for writing beautiful code.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, globally distributed environment.


Minimum Qualifications:


  • 10+ years of experience in full stack development.
  • Hands-on experience with pure PHP , vanilla JavaScript , MySQL , PostgreSQL , SQL , and React in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to build solutions from scratch without relying on frameworks.
  • Proven experience leading complex projects from concept to deployment.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC principles and agile methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems

  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

  • 8+ years of professional Java development experience, ideally in financial services.

  • Strong understanding of multi-threading, concurrency, and performance tuning in Java.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot real-time trading issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Available and ready to provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.

title: Data Annotation & Content Writing Specialist – AI Training
description:
About the Role:


We are looking for detail-oriented and language-savvy professionals to support AI training through high-quality data annotation, content writing, and linguistic evaluation. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy working with language, structured data, and written content, and who are interested in contributing to the development of AI and NLP systems. You will play a key role in improving model accuracy, clarity, and usability by creating, reviewing, and annotating language data.


Job Title: Data Annotation & Content Writing Specialist – AI Training


Experience Level: Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in any discipline (Linguistics, English, Journalism, Mass Communication, or related fields preferred)


Key Responsibilities:

  • Annotate and label text, audio, or image data according to defined project guidelines.
  • Create, rewrite, and edit content such as prompts, responses, summaries, or examples for AI training.
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, grammar, tone, and clarity.
  • Identify and flag issues related to ambiguity, bias, factual errors, or inconsistencies in content.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) checks to ensure annotated and written data meets required standards.
  • Follow detailed instructions and annotation schemas with high attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to improve annotation guidelines and content quality.


Qualifications:

  • Strong written English skills with good grammar, vocabulary, and sentence structure.
  • Ability to understand and follow detailed guidelines and workflows.
  • Experience in data annotation, content writing, editing, or reviewing is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with AI, NLP, or language models is a plus but not mandatory.
  • High attention to detail, consistency, and quality.
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

title: Data Engineer
description:
We’re Hiring: Data Engineer


We’re looking for a Data Engineer with solid Machine Learning and Optimization experience. This is a full-time remote position on a PJ contract , offering the opportunity to work on challenging and impactful projects.


Skills:

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior (inglês fluente)

Experiência Requerida

  • Experiência recomendada: Atuação em desenvolvimento de aplicações de BI.
  • Capacidade de identificar riscos técnicos e de segurança, bem como propor ações de mitigação.
  • Experiência prática com práticas de Gerenciamento de Configuração e Liberação (Configuration & Release Management).
  • Participação em modificações de software durante os testes de integração.
  • Compreensão dos requisitos dos stakeholders e documentação desses requisitos sob orientação.
  • Propor mudanças para melhorar a eficiência e/ou reduzir custos operacionais ou de manutenção.
  • Criar boas práticas e propor melhorias.
  • Levantar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, incluindo requisitos de segurança da informação, junto aos stakeholders, e documentá-los.

Competências Obrigatórias

  • Experiência comprovada na construção e gerenciamento de workflows de ETL e jobs no Databricks.
  • Forte expertise em Python, SQL e frameworks de processamento distribuído de dados (ex.: Spark).
  • Conhecimento prático em desenvolvimento Python.
  • Base sólida em controle de versão utilizando Git.
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps.
  • Entendimento de Databricks Unity Catalog, clusters e SQL Warehouses.
  • Experiência com Azure Data Factory.
  • Facilidade no uso de ferramentas de linha de comando (CLI) e scripts (ex.: Azure CLI, Databricks CLI).
  • Familiaridade com app registrations e service principals.

Competências Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento dos setores industrial, automotivo ou de logística.
  • Experiência de trabalho com equipes europeias.
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como Azure Functions e Azure Web Apps.
  • Vivência em integrações de APIs e mensageria baseada em JSON.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área correlata.

Idioma:

Imprescindível inglês fluente para atuar com equipes internacionais


CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centres, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.



Job Title: Site Reliability Operations

Location: Brazil (Remote)



Ideal Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or comparable experience.
  • Advanced AWS Certifications strongly preferred
  • 3–5+ years of experience working in both Windows and Linux environments, with demonstrated success in advanced troubleshooting and administration.
  • Proven proficiency in monitoring and alerting tools such as Nagios, New Relic, SumoLogic, AWS CloudWatch, and related technologies.
  • Strong scripting or programming skills in PowerShell, Python, or a similar language; ability to automate repetitive tasks and streamline operations.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and urgent issues in a fast-paced setting.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain complex technical issues to stakeholders at various technical levels.
  • Comfortable completing annual role-based training and certification assignments; dedicated to continual learning and development.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently on complex tasks and to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.




Why join Sonata Software?

At Sonata, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build never seen before solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you will not be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Sonata Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Data Tech Lead
description:
Estamos procurando uma pessoa de tecnologia de dados experiente e inovador para liderar a estratégia de dados e a execução técnica. Esta função envolve liderar uma equipe de profissionais de dados, discutir arquiteturas de dados robustas e garantir a entrega de soluções de dados escaláveis e de alta qualidade que impulsionam a inteligência de negócios e a eficiência operacional.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Liderar e orientar uma equipe de engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e analistas de dados, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alto desempenho.
  • Discutir a arquitetura geral de dados, incluindo armazenamento de dados, data lakes, processos ETL/ELT e estruturas de governança de dados, considerando a escala ideal e o tempo de lançamento no mercado.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escalonáveis e confiáveis usando tecnologias apropriadas (por exemplo, Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka).
  • Colaborar com produtos, engenharia, e equipes de negócios para entender os requisitos de dados e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados em todas as plataformas e sistemas de dados.
  • Impulsionar a adoção das melhores práticas em engenharia de dados, modelagem de dados e operações de dados.
  • Avaliar e recomendar novas tecnologias, processos e ferramentas para aprimorar e acelerar nossos componentes e capacidades de dados.
  • Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos relacionados a dados, otimizando o desempenho e a confiabilidade.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor e os avanços em tecnologias e metodologias de dados.
  • Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico de iniciativas de dados e roteiro de dados de longo prazo.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado;
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, arquitetura de dados ou função semelhante com foco em dados, com pelo menos 2 anos em capacidade de liderança técnica.


  • Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência liderando projetos de dados.


  • Forte proficiência em SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação comumente usada em engenharia de dados (por exemplo, Python, Scala, Java).


  • Ampla experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Azure e Databricks) e seus respectivos serviços de dados. (por exemplo, Spark, Hadoop, Kafka) é altamente desejável.


  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar, orientar e inspirar uma equipe técnica.


  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, interpessoais e de resolução de problemas.


  • Forte pensamento analítico e uma abordagem baseada em dados para a tomada de decisões.

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node.js Sênior
description:
Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que estamos Buscando?

Desenvolvedor Back-End para participar da refatoração de demandas estruturais, com foco na revisão de processos e sistemas de integração e disponibilização de dados, desenvolvendo a solução tecnológica considerando escalabilidade, disponibilidade, segurança e monitoria. Atender as necessidades das áreas de negócios, observando os padrões e as diretivas corporativas. Disseminar conhecimento com seus pares, documentando, comunicando e viabilizando o acesso às informações. Ter atitude de dono, aplicando visão forense e buscando as melhores práticas com foco nos resultados e entregas. Levantar estimativas para as soluções propostas, com bom raciocínio lógico, senso crítico, organização, proatividade e boa capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e desenvolvimento em NodeJs (JavaScript, desejável TypeScript), com testes unitários e de integração e documentação de APIs REST e Async API.

• Atuação no desenvolvimento de microsserviços, arquiteturas orientadas a serviços e eventos (SOA/EDA), com implementação de tracing, logging, containers e CI/CD.

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, versionamento de código, NPM/Yarn e metodologias ágeis (Scrum e Kanban).

• Experiência em sustentação de aplicações, monitoria, troubleshooting, melhoria contínua e repasse para equipes de suporte.

• Diferencial para Java (Spring Boot e Spring Batch), Scala, Python, Kubernetes, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Service Bus, SQS) e protocolos HTTP/HTTPS, AMQP e TCP.

• Vivência com segurança da informação (LGPD/GDPR), ambientes financeiros, SaaS/DaaS, integração de dados e ferramentas de transferência de arquivos.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Are you a talented Human Resources expet looking for an exciting new challenge? We are seeking a HR Specialist (preferred) from Brazil, with proven expertise in Human Resources, who is ready and willing to help us build a strong international team—either by working remotely from Brazil or by relocating to Croatia.

Key Requirements:

• Expert knowledge and experience in Human Resources (minimum 2–5 years preferred)

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field

• Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken)

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Strong motivation to build a career in an international environment

What We Offer:

• Competitive average salary for HR specialists in Brazil: 6,500–7,750 BRL/month (approx. 1,020–1,215 EUR/month)

• Attractive monthly bonus: 5 EUR for every worker hired

• Additional retention bonus: 10 EUR for every worker who remains in Croatia for 6 months

• Monthly bonuses can reach around 1,000–2,000 EUR, depending on performance and hiring results

• Option to work remotely from Brazil or relocate to Croatia

• If you choose to work in Croatia: paid apartment provided

• Opportunity for professional growth in a dynamic, international team

• Support with relocation and integration in Europe

Key Responsibilities:

• Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the entire recruitment process for various roles, including drafting job descriptions, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, conducting interviews, and coordinating the hiring process with relevant departments.

• Onboarding & Integration: Organize and execute onboarding programs for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the company—whether they are working remotely from Brazil or relocating to Croatia.

• Employee Support: Serve as the main point of contact for employee questions and concerns, providing guidance on HR policies, benefits, and company procedures.

• Documentation & Compliance: Prepare and maintain accurate employee records, contracts, and documentation in compliance with Croatian and international labor laws.

• Performance Tracking: Monitor employee performance and retention, provide regular feedback to management, and support the implementation of performance improvement plans.

• Retention & Engagement: Develop and implement strategies to improve employee satisfaction and retention, including organizing team-building activities and wellness initiatives.

• Relocation Assistance: For employees relocating to Croatia, provide support with visa applications, travel arrangements, and settling into their new environment, including coordinating housing (paid apartment provided).

• Collaboration: Work closely with management and other departments to understand staffing needs and contribute to the development of HR policies and best practices.

• Reporting: Generate regular reports on recruitment, onboarding, and retention metrics, as well as bonus eligibility for hired and retained employees.

title: Agentic AI Developer - Agentes de Inteligência Artificial
description:
Sobre a TRUTIME

A TRUTIME não está contratando um desenvolvedor.

Estamos abrindo espaço para alguém assumir controle de um sistema operacional de agentes autônomos , projetado para decidir e agir antes do mercado. Enquanto 99% das empresas ainda usam IA para responder quando alguém chama, nós fazemos o oposto.


Nossos agentes iniciam. Agem. Executam.


O problema que atacamos é brutalmente simples: Empresas perdem dinheiro porque demoram em responder., demoram para decidir, demoram para agir. E demora não escala.


A TRUTIME existe para substituir atraso por infraestrutura. Com código rodando em produção.


O que você vai construir aqui

Aqui você não vai “experimentar IA”. Você vai operar IA em ambiente real de negócio .

Na prática, você irá:

  • Construir agentes autônomos orientados a ação , (- conversa + ação)
  • Projetar sistemas right-time
  • Orquestrar agentes que operam 24/7 em canais reais (voz, WhatsApp, sistemas comerciais)
  • Definir arquitetura, limites de autonomia, fallback e controle de risco
  • Criar loops de decisão baseados em contexto, estado e prioridade
  • Ver seu código criar receita real , todos os dias


Na TRUTIME, seu código fala primeiro no mercado.


O NÍVEL:

O nível é alto e a responsabilidade também.

Autonomia é pré-requisito.


Se você é bom, isso vai te atrair. Se você é excelente, isso vai te incomodar, até você participar.


Depois de entender que tempo é a única vantagem que não pode ser copiada , trabalhar na construção de qualquer outro tipo de sistema operacional não vai fazer sentido.


A TRUTIME NÃO É PARA TODO MUNDO.

É para quem vai construir algo que o mercado ainda não sabe pedir.


Stack e Arquitetura (o que esperamos que você domine ou saiba decidir)

Atuando como especialista em agentic commerce , o stack esperado gira em torno de:


LINGUAGENS E RUNTIME

  • Python (core de agentes, decisão, orquestração)
  • Node.js (integrações, tempo real, pipelines de comunicação)
  • Experiência com ambientes assíncronos e concorrentes

LLMs e IA

  • Anthropic / OpenAI API ou equivalentes (LLMs como motores cognitivos)
  • Prompting estruturado + function calling + tool usage
  • State management para agentes (memória curta, média e longa)
  • Avaliação e observabilidade de agentes (não só accuracy)

AGENTIC SYSTEMS

  • Orquestração multi-agente
  • Definição clara de autonomia, limites e exceções
  • Sistemas orientados a eventos e decisão
  • Design de fallback humano e degradação controlada

INFRA

  • APIs REST e/ou WebSockets
  • Cloud (AWS)
  • Serverless quando fizer sentido. Stateful quando for necessário
  • Filas, jobs, retries, idempotência

DADOS E INTEGRAÇÕES

  • CRMs, ERPs, sistemas de vendas ou comunicação
  • Logs, métricas e rastreabilidade de decisão
  • Análise de performance baseada em impacto de negócio


O que diferencia um candidato forte

  • Já construiu algo que operou sem supervisão constante
  • Entende que agente bom não é o que “fala bonito”, é o que avança no pipeline de vendas
  • Consegue pensar arquitetura antes de código
  • Não tem apego dogmático a frameworks
  • Consegue discutir trade-offs entre velocidade, risco e impacto


Modelo de trabalho

  • Full-time
  • Remoto
  • Alta autonomia
  • Alta cobrança
  • Zero burocracia
  • Proximidade direta com estratégia de negócio.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a Customer Success Manager, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
The Opportunity We are an investment firm building a next-generation \"AI Operating System\" to power our deal flow and investor relations. We are looking for a Low-Code Engineer who can own our operations stack.


We aren't looking for someone to just connect simple triggers (Zapier-style). We need an architect who can build complex, multi-step workflows that fetch unstructured data (call transcripts, email history), process it via LLMs (Claude/GPT), and execute high-stakes communications with precision.


What You Will Build (General Scope)

  • AI-Driven Communications: Workflows that draft hyper-personalized emails to investors and clients by referencing historical data and context.
  • Intelligent Reporting Loops: Systems that periodically query our database to aggregate activity logs and generate strategic summaries for stakeholders.
  • Data Synchronization: Ensuring seamless data flow between our CRM (Attio), Database (Supabase), and Deal Room (Airtable).
  • Contextual RAG: Building logic that pulls specific past interactions (transcripts) to inform future AI outputs.

The Tech Stack

  • Orchestration: n8n (Primary requirement).
  • Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL).
  • CRM: Attio & Airtable.
  • AI: Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) & OpenAI APIs.

Who You Are

  • n8n Expert: You are comfortable using Code Nodes (JavaScript) to manipulate JSON data, handle error routing, and manage complex logic trees.
  • Data Literate: You are comfortable writing SQL queries (Supabase) to fetch, filter, and aggregate specific datasets (e.g., \"Fetch interactions from the last 48 hours\").
  • Prompt Engineer: You understand how to structure System vs. User prompts to prevent hallucinations and ensure strict formatting compliance.
  • Detail Oriented: We automate high-value interactions. You understand the importance of testing and \"kill-switches\" to prevent errors.

description:
The Opportunity We are an investment firm building a next-generation \"AI Operating System\" to power our deal flow and investor relations. We are looking for a Low-Code Engineer who can own our operations stack.


We aren't looking for someone to just connect simple triggers (Zapier-style). We need an architect who can build complex, multi-step workflows that fetch unstructured data (call transcripts, email history), process it via LLMs (Claude/GPT), and execute high-stakes communications with precision.


What You Will Build (General Scope)

  • AI-Driven Communications: Workflows that draft hyper-personalized emails to investors and clients by referencing historical data and context.
  • Intelligent Reporting Loops: Systems that periodically query our database to aggregate activity logs and generate strategic summaries for stakeholders.
  • Data Synchronization: Ensuring seamless data flow between our CRM (Attio), Database (Supabase), and Deal Room (Airtable).
  • Contextual RAG: Building logic that pulls specific past interactions (transcripts) to inform future AI outputs.

The Tech Stack

  • Orchestration: n8n (Primary requirement).
  • Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL).
  • CRM: Attio & Airtable.
  • AI: Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) & OpenAI APIs.

Who You Are

  • n8n Expert: You are comfortable using Code Nodes (JavaScript) to manipulate JSON data, handle error routing, and manage complex logic trees.
  • Data Literate: You are comfortable writing SQL queries (Supabase) to fetch, filter, and aggregate specific datasets (e.g., \"Fetch interactions from the last 48 hours\").
  • Prompt Engineer: You understand how to structure System vs. User prompts to prevent hallucinations and ensure strict formatting compliance.
  • Detail Oriented: We automate high-value interactions. You understand the importance of testing and \"kill-switches\" to prevent errors.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
About You

You are a technical, AI-enabled Business Analyst who thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations. You prioritize progress over perfection and are able to move initiatives forward even when not all variables are fully defined.

You work autonomously, take ownership of outcomes, and stay highly engaged in delivery and execution.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst supporting integration-heavy platforms.
  • Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows.
  • Experience reviewing logs, analyzing defects, and supporting production issue triage.
  • Experience onboarding and supporting external API or integration partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously within self-managed Agile teams.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments.
  • Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers.
  • Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering teams and external API/integration partners.
  • Own the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical defects and enhancement requests.
  • Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps.
  • Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment.
  • Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations.


Qualifications

  • Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure DevOps / Jira), defect triage, and production support.
  • Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.
